 publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{p["batch"]}.json';receipt=read_json(publication);assert receipt['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'

observed=datetime.fromisoformat(snapshot['observed_at_utc']);anchor=snapshot['anchors'][0];hours=(observed-datetime.fromisoformat(anchor['commit_at_utc'])).total_seconds()/3600
forecast=[]
